description: This file defines the MutableMessageSource interface, which extends Spring's MessageSource and HierarchicalMessageSource interfaces to provide additional methods for managing message resources, including retrieving, adding, removing, and merging presentation messages in different locales.

classes.name: MutableMessageSource
classes.description: An interface extending Spring's MessageSource and HierarchicalMessageSource to support mutable message sources with methods for managing presentation messages.

methods.name: getLocales
methods.description: Returns the collection of locales for which messages are available in this source.

methods.name: getPresentations
methods.description: Returns all available presentation messages in the source.

methods.name: getPresentationsInLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of presentation messages for a specific locale.

methods.name: addPresentation
methods.description: Adds a presentation message to the source, overwriting any existing message with the same code and locale.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific presentation message for a given key and locale.

methods.name: removePresentation
methods.description: Removes a presentation message from the source.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges messages from another MutableMessageSource into this one, with an option to overwrite existing messages.
